results.title: Sento
results.overview: The daily grind of the elderly cleaner of a Japanese bathhouse is disrupted when a young man attempts suicide.

results.title: A Hint of Love
results.overview: Mélanie, a lawyer suffering from an incurable disease, has decided it’s time to enjoy life! She whisks Benjamin, her childhood friend, off on a road trip to Spain to explore their sensuality in a brothel. Now here they are, onboard a rundown van driven by Lucas, a burly chauffeur freshly released from jail. Contrary to Mélanie, Benjamin does not seem in any hurry to arrive. Indeed, he does everything he can to prolong this improbable journey with his good friend.

results.title: Stinker
results.overview: While the district administration prepares for the arrival of high-ranking guests, local alcoholic Sadyq Ospanovich solves intergalactic problems.  Two large-scale events, developing simultaneously, lead to an inevitable conflict. The life-weary saleswoman Nadezhda and the naive policeman Baur find themselves between two fires.

results.title: Being Blue
results.overview: Filmed during a residency at Prospect Cottage, Dungeness, former home of artist, filmmaker and gay rights activist Derek Jarman, Being Blue touches impressionistically on themes of sexuality, queer British life, art making, and nature.

results.title: Invisible People
results.overview: Invisible People is a multi-layered depiction of the unique Japanese contemporary dance Butoh that flows between revolt, eroticism, trance, prayer, ancestral experience, and physical anonymity. The film gradually drifts away from its core issue and becomes a general portrayal of life itself, with all its unforeseen strokes of fate and strange micro-connections.

results.title: We are Greenland: Football Is Freedom
results.original_title: We are Greenland: Football Is Freedom
results.overview: A documentary about five football players from Greenland and their coach, who on behalf of their country dream about being accepted as a part of the global football community. They want to show the world what Greenland can achieve! While their biggest dream is to play in the WC qualification. Currently it is impossible because they are not recognised as a UN nation and therefore the team is focusing on Island Games - The Islands mini Olympics. The Football pitches in Greenland are covered with ice and snow for the most part of the year which means they only have six weeks of training and preparation for the tournament. Despite the tough conditions Greenland are aiming for winning Island Games, meanwhile the football association of Greenland are fighting behind the scenes to become a recognised nation amongst the UN. This is a true David and Goliath story about bureaucracy and big football business, which meets national identity, passion and ambition.

results.title: I F*cking Hate You!
results.overview: After a flat tire leaves Michelle and her brother, David, stranded on their way to her wedding, the two siblings must put their differences aside if they want to survive.

results.title: Jason and Shirley Revisited
results.overview: A radical revisitation. This updated version of Stephen Winter’s 2015 film unearths the ghosts of Jason and Shirley, restaging the volatile 12-hour shoot of the 1967 documentary Portrait of Jason—held at the Chelsea Hotel—which blurred the line between subject and storyteller. Jason Holliday, a sharp-witted Black gay man, whose identity splits between personas–performer, hustler, muse, provocateur–is once again in the room with Shirley Clarke, the Oscar-winning filmmaker who insisted on framing his life. Now, with newly unearthed footage, the director returns 10 years later, not to resolve the contradictions, but to reopen them. What was once a document becomes a haunting, a conversation with what was left outside the frame. Time folds. Power shifts. And Jason, still impossible to contain, speaks back.

results.title: Countdown: Taylor vs. Serrano
results.overview: Two elite boxers, Katie Taylor and Amanda Serrano, prepare for their epic trilogy finale, a live-streamed match on Netflix July 11. Uma Thurman narrates their rigorous training journey.

results.title: Discreet
results.overview: A young man’s desire spirals into obsession as he tries to reshape himself in the image of someone else.

results.title: The Touring Band
results.overview: Cesare Dell'Anna is an Italian trumpeter as talented as he is whimsical. Heir to a family of brass band musicians, he and his group Hotel Albania have launched a musical genre steeped in the rhythms brought by Balkan migrants. During summertime, everything is a pretext for playing music on big stages as well as village squares.

results.title: Snow Firefighter
results.overview: This is a story about a snowman who was made by firefighters at a fire station out of boredom. The snowman comes to life and wants to become a brave firefighter just like his creators. And although fire is not his element, and the firefighters try to protect the snowman from fire, in the end he becomes a Snow Firefighter!

results.title: No Escape
results.overview: Set against the sweeping backdrop of China’s Inner Mongolian grasslands in the early 1990s, Impossible to Escape is a visceral crime-action thriller that pits relentless justice against ruthless lawlessness. Directed by Feng Baoning, the film follows veteran detective Zhang Xiao (played by Su Xin), a seasoned officer leading a task force to dismantle the brutal criminal empire of Guan Xiongfei (Du Yiheng), a merciless gangster terrorizing the region with audacious heists and savage violence.

results.title: The Grotto
results.overview: Vicky, a hot-headed corporate media executive, becomes obsessed with a young writer's TV show idea in the midst of an abusive relationship that she experiences solely over the phone.

results.title: Timpi Tampa
results.overview: After his mother develops cancer from dépigmentation, Khalilou fights toxic beauty standards. Disguised as Leila, he enters the "Miss Students" pageant, where light skin reigns, to give dark-skinned girls a chance to shine.

results.title: Baby
results.overview: Shot in one continuous take that explores themes of miscarriage, abusive relationships and womanhood. After discovering her own miscarriage, a young woman attempts to conceal this reality from her dysfunctional boyfriend and come to terms with her.

results.title: Uncanny
results.overview: In his quest for love, introverted Jordan (James Podmore) is captivated by the realm of online dating and soon finds himself entangled in a web of terrors when he connects with Amanda (Rachael Caulton)...
